title: The restarted service reports the updater result in the inbox and on the dashboard
goal: After an update started from inside the service, the restarted service reads the updater receipt and reports applied, refused or uncertain like the scheduled apply
acceptance: The updater writes its result where the restarted service reads it once
The inbox (Telegram, dashboard) gets the same applied/refused/uncertain text as a scheduled apply
A result is reported exactly once
privacy: Neutral fixtures only; no personal data.
escalation: A material scope or effort increase goes to the owner

effort.basis: Estimated 2026-11-23 at agent speed. Not a measurement.
